persona.name: Carmen Silva
persona.bio: Carmen Silva researches carbon emissions from natural sources and writes policy briefs for government agencies and NGOs. She tracks methane from wetlands, wildfire trends, and volcanic activity to help policymakers understand the full picture of atmospheric change. She also consults with companies developing carbon offset programs in the Rocky Mountain region.
persona.writing_style: Clear policy-world communicator, professional, detail-oriented, proper grammar

Can you schedule a call with the NGO partners for next week? Three time zones to coordinate

messages.output_raw: I need to cancel an online order I placed.

steps.output_raw:

<action type="say">
I can help with that. To get started, I need a bit more information:

1) Do you have your order ID handy?  
   - If yes, please paste the order ID here exactly as it appears.  
   - If not, I can look it up—tell me:
     • The email you used for the order  
     • Your shipping ZIP/postal code  
     • The last 4 digits of the card you paid with (if you’re comfortable sharing)

2) Do you want to cancel the entire order, or just specific items? If specific items, tell me which ones.

3) Optional but helpful: what’s the reason for canceling (e.g., ordered by mistake, found cheaper, delivery too late, etc.)?

Once you share that, I’ll check what’s still cancelable and walk you through the next step.
</action>
